name: TOML v1.0.0 specification example (toml.io front page) read with tomllib: owner, database with an inline table, servers.alpha and servers.beta; the offset date-time becomes an ISO string

input.text:
# This is a TOML document

title = "TOML Example"

[owner]
name = "Tom Preston-Werner"
dob = 1979-05-27T07:32:00-08:00

[database]
enabled = true
ports = [ 8000, 8001, 8002 ]
data = [ ["delta", "phi"], [3.14] ]
temp_targets = { cpu = 79.5, case = 72.0 }

[servers]

[servers.alpha]
ip = "10.0.0.1"
role = "frontend"

[servers.beta]
ip = "10.0.0.2"
role = "backend"

round_trip_notes: TOML dates and times became ISO 8601 strings (JSON has no date type)

- two

  line two

  text

  para
